name: trust
title: Trust
description: Take one sentence and come back with a product that runs, going through the whole chain alone and writing down every decision taken in the user's place.
notes:
## Trust

One sentence in, a product that runs out. `trust` goes through the whole Veebee chain alone (open source, MIT): `eureka`, `define`, `style`, `ticketise`, `autopilot`, answering every question itself.

**It asks the user nothing**, and writes down every decision it took in their place.

- Three stops only: no sentence at all, a first push to an existing remote (other people may be behind it), and a sentence asking for something that should not be built. Everything else it decides.
- `.veebee/trust/decisions.md` is written as the run goes, each decision with a reason that is something in the sentence, a checked fact, or a named convention. Never a preference with nothing behind it. When two options are close, it takes the reversible one.
- **One slice.** The size is settled before `define`'s first question: the smallest version that stands on its own, no milestones, everything else into `features.md` under *plus tard*. A question whose answer would not change the code is not asked at all.
- **Drawn on the spot**, not pasted: `style`'s charter goes to the design skill actually installed (built-in `design`, else `frontend-design`, else `design-frontend-dev`) and the result lands in `.veebee/design/`.
- **Tickets stay files.** Nothing is pushed to a tracker, even a connected one.
- **A fresh directory stays local**: `git init`, a commit per ticket into `main` after the same checks, no remote, no pull request, nothing outward. An existing repository with a remote gets the normal pull request flow after the one confirmation.
- It picks the stack, plainest thing that runs the idea, no paid service and no key the user does not have, and names it in the decisions.
- A product question that would block `autopilot` is answered with the smallest reversible choice. Money, authentication, permissions and personal data are never faked, and no check is ever bypassed.
- It runs the product and goes through it before saying a word, and says the failure first when there is one.
- `scripts/chain.py` reads where the run stands from disk, so an interrupted run picks up where it left off.

Triggers: "fais-moi un truc qui…", "je te fais confiance", "lance trust", "just build it", "make me a…". Not for a product the user wants to shape themselves: that is `eureka` then `define`.

No secrets, no environment variables. Source: https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/veebee-skills

changes: First Companion release, from repository v0.14.0. Runs eureka, define, style, ticketise and autopilot by itself from one sentence.
Asks nothing: three stops only, a missing sentence, a first push to an existing remote, and something that should not be built.
Every decision taken in the user's place is written to .veebee/trust/decisions.md as it happens, with a traceable reason.
One slice only: the smallest version that stands alone, the rest into features.md under plus tard.
The design is drawn on the spot with the design skill actually installed, not handed out as a prompt to paste.
Tickets stay files; a fresh directory stays local with no remote and no pull request.
It picks and names the stack, answers the product questions autopilot would block on, and never fakes money, auth, permissions or personal data.
It runs the product before claiming it works, and says the failure first when there is one.
